stem.text: A metal plate of uniform thickness is connected to a cell as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit with a cell at the top and a trapezium-shaped metal plate in the lower branch, labelled metal plate viewed from above; an arrow labelled electron flow points left along the lower wire.

stem.text: Electrons move clockwise around the circuit.
Which statement about the metal plate is correct?

A.text: The average drift speed of the conduction electrons decreases as they move from right to left through the plate.

B.text: The average drift speed of the conduction electrons increases as they move from right to left through the plate.

C.text: The number density of the conduction electrons decreases from right to left through the plate.

D.text: The number density of the conduction electrons increases from right to left through the plate.
